subject: Mutual action checklist and staged cutover plan for LumenIQ evaluation
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@lumeniq.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-13T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Updated MAP + evaluation kickoff materials

Hi Elaine —

Attaching an updated mutual action plan (MAP) and the initial evaluation plan PDF for the trial environment. Key things in this version:
- Proposed evaluation window: 2027-01-11 to 2027-01-25 (we can narrow).
- Staging cutover candidate: 2027-01-09 weekend (low traffic).
- Owners column filled for the first pass — see Marissa for technical tasks, Ben for CS milestones, Karthik for rollout gating.

Please review the MAP and the eval plan and flag any constraints you have around the proposed go-live week. Specific asks from your side we flagged as "Elaine input needed" in column H.

Attachments: LumenIQ_MAP_v2.xlsx, LumenIQ_eval_plan_v1.pdf

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal alignment (Redwood) — confirm owners and runbook draft — by 2026-12-16.
2) Joint checkpoint call (weekly MAP touch) — pick a time the week of 12/21; Elaine, what times work for you?

Thanks — looking forward to getting the eval scheduled.

—
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0163

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@lumeniq.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: LumenIQ Infra <infra@lumeniq.com>
Date: 2026-12-14T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Updated MAP + evaluation kickoff materials

Thanks Priyom — appreciate the detail. Quick responses: 
- Evaluation window looks fine but can we change go-live target to 2027-01-12 (Tuesday) to align with our release calendar?
- Staging cutover on 2027-01-09 looks acceptable; please confirm maintenance window (expected II).
- We will need SOC2 evidence and an SPA for the eval environment access — can you attach the SOC2 bundle?

I have looped in our infra team (infra@lumeniq.com) to confirm port/IP allowlisting and any network requirements. Also tagging procurement; they may have contract milestones once we finish the eval and hit the MAP acceptance criteria.

For the weekly checkpoint, Tue 12/22 or Wed 12/23 morning PST works for us.

—
Elaine Park
Director, Product Integration | LumenIQ
elaine.park@lumeniq.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@lumeniq.com>
Date: 2026-12-16T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Updated MAP + evaluation kickoff materials — internal owners + runbook draft

Great, looping in the responses and next actions. I pulled the sections we need to finalise and sketched a runbook draft attached (runbook_draft.md). High-level proposed owner assignments: 
- Staging cutover coordination & IP allowlist: Karthik (technical PM)
- Validation scripts / smoke tests + acceptance criteria: Marissa (SE)
- Customer success checkpoints & communication cadence: Ben (CS)
- Rollback plan / canary fallback: Ben + Karthik

Specific open items that need confirmation before we lock dates:
1) Exact maintenance window on 2027-01-09 (we need 2-hour exclusive window).
2) SOC2 bundle delivery — Priyom, can you send the SOC2 evidence zip?
3) Load test schedule for pre-cutover performance verification (target Jan 05) — Ben to own.

Attached: runbook_draft.md

I will also populate the shared MAP doc with these owner assignments: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcdExampleSharedMAP

Marissa
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@lumeniq.com>
Date: 2026-12-17T14:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Updated MAP + evaluation kickoff materials — load test & rollback owner

Acknowledged — I will own the load test plan and the rollback verification. Quick notes:
- Schedule load tests for 2027-01-05 and run a second sanity pass on 2027-01-08 (off-hours).
- I will deliver a CSV with the loadtest schedule and endpoints by 2026-12-20 (attachment: loadtest_schedule.csv).
- For rollback: we'll keep the previous model routing and autoscale policy as the fallback; Karthik, can you confirm the exact rollback command sequence (kubectl/infra steps) so I can include it in the runbook?

Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@lumeniq.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: MAP update: confirmed owners, docs and evidence bundle

Elaine —

Attached the SOC2 evidence bundle you requested and a refreshed MAP with the owner column locked. High level update:
- Go-live (soft): 2027-01-12 (Tue) — final cutover target.
- Staging cutover: 2027-01-09 (Sun) — 02:00–04:00 PST window (2 hours).
- Load tests scheduled: 2027-01-05 & 2027-01-08 (Ben).
- Final acceptance gate: smoke tests pass + no critical regressions + security checklist sign-off.

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_bundle.zip, LumenIQ_MAP_v2.xlsx

Action owners summary (per MAP):
- Karthik: IP allowlist, cutover orchestration, rollback command sequence
- Marissa: smoke tests, validation scripts, runbook edits
- Ben: load testing, rollback verification, customer communication cadence
- Priyom: commercial milestones, procurement cadence, contract sign-off liaison

Next checkpoint: weekly MAP sync on 2026-12-22 at 09:00 PST (confirmed). Link to shared MAP and runbook above. I will update HubSpot after this note: https://hubspot.com/deal/LQ-5421

Thanks team — prepping the DocuSign and acceptance checklist after the load test run.

—
Priyom

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@lumeniq.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: LumenIQ Infra <infra@lumeniq.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-21T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP update: confirmed owners, docs and evidence bundle

Thanks Priyom and team — this looks good from our side. We confirm the following: 
- Go-live week target 2027-01-12 is acceptable.
- Staging cutover maintenance window 2027-01-09 02:00–04:00 PST is approved by infra (they will provide allowlist ticket).
- Procurement: will await acceptance criteria and then initiate the PO process.

Two small asks before the 12/22 sync: 
1) Please paste the rollback command sequence (Karthik) into the runbook as a numbered checklist.
2) If possible, provide a short runbook excerpt in the weekly sync slide deck summarising the go/no-go criteria (max one slide).

We will open a support case as well so your SREs have a dedicated incident channel during cutover.

Elaine
